items.title: Congress reins pass to Gagan Thapa and Bishwa Prakash Sharma
items.desc: Thapa’s election as president and Sharma’s unopposed rise as senior vice-president mark a generational shift, but the pair inherit a party still divided by factional rivalries and an entrenched political culture.
